headline: Woman Driver Completes First Transcontinental Automobile Journey
dispatch: Alice Huyler Ramsey rolled into San Francisco yesterday, completing a 59-day drive from New York City and becoming the first woman to pilot an automobile across the contiguous United States. Ramsey navigated roads, mud, and desert with three passengers in her Maxwell automobile. The journey covered more than 3,800 miles across eleven states.
answer: Alice Ramsey first woman to drive across the US, 1909
